title: ADA Accessibility Concerns
description: Use this service request to report physical barriers or constraints within citywide services, activities, or facilities (i.e., participation or communication concerns for public programs, services, or activities; inaccessible, missing, or damaged pedestrian elements such as pedestrian signals, crossings, sidewalks, or curb ramps; or access barriers for, at or in a city facility or park). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.
department: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment

options: No Signage (to accessible facilities - restroom, ramps, parking, entry, etc.)
No Right-of-Way Access (curb, sidewalk, ramp, pedestrian crossing, signal)
Trip Hazard (broken, missing, damaged sidewalk, etc.)

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about an accessibility barrier or grievance.
actions.why: Report a physical or communication barrier in a City service, activity, facility, park, or pedestrian route, including inaccessible restrooms or parking, missing signage, service-animal accommodation, damaged sidewalks or curb ramps, pedestrian signals or crossings, and right-of-way access. The 311 request form also offers Fair Housing Complaint (discrimination) and asks about the incident, property type, and any prior attempt to resolve it through a City department.
actions.who: Office of Housing and Community Empowerment
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "ADA/Fair Housing Complaints" > Choose "ADA Accessibility Concerns"
